prompt: I hand-wrote a new expected/foo.out file for a ZDB test under contrib/zdb/regress by running the SQL through pg_regress and capturing its output. Now `make install installcheck-default` reports a diff against my expected file even though the query results look right to me. What's going on?

answer_points: installcheck-default runs through pg_isolation2_regress (psycopg2-based executor), not pg_regress (psql-based executor) — the two executors produce different output formats
You cannot validate an expected .out file by running it through pg_regress; the command tags, column alignment, and trailing whitespace differ between the two executors

It is fine to hand-write the expected file, but its format must match pg_isolation2_regress conventions: single-line SQL echo, command tags like CREATE/INSERT N/DROP, left-justified (ljust) column alignment with trailing spaces
Reference the actual output already produced under results/ in the regress directory to get the exact format right, rather than guessing
gotcha_points: did NOT validate/generate the expected .out file using pg_regress
did NOT assume pg_regress and pg_isolation2_regress produce the same output formatting
